species_guide.title: Field Reference Catalogue
species_guide.subtitle: Diagnostic field marks, ecology, conservation status and AUSLAN sign description for every species the model recognises. Cards are ordered by EPBC Act priority.
species_guide.footer_title: How the model recognises these species
species_guide.footer_text: The CNN was retrained on ~4,970 images sourced from iNaturalist Australia and the Atlas of Living Australia, using transfer learning over EfficientNetB4 (ImageNet pretrained) and fine-tuned for 30 epochs. Test accuracy is 75.6 % with an F1-macro of 0.76 across the 8 species. Per-species F1 ranges from 0.69 (Peregrine Falcon) to 0.85 (Black-shouldered Kite).
species_guide.references: References: Olsen et al. (1993); Marchant & Higgins (1993); Debus (1998); DAWE (2021); Atlas of Living Australia (2024).

data.export_intro: Download your observations for personal use, scientific analysis, or submission to the Atlas of Living Australia and global biodiversity platforms.
data.export_internal_desc: All your saved observations in the application's native format. Useful for personal logs and local analysis.
data.export_dwc_desc: Standardised biodiversity format following the TDWG Darwin Core schema. Ready to upload to the Atlas of Living Australia's Sightings portal or any GBIF data publisher.
data.export_feedback_desc: Every correction submitted via the feedback button. Used as the input for the next model retraining cycle.
data.ala_howto_title: How to upload to the Atlas of Living Australia
data.ala_howto_step1: Sign in (or create a free account) at www.ala.org.au.
data.ala_howto_step2: Go to My Profile → My Sightings → Submit a sighting list.
data.ala_howto_step3: Upload the raptor_au_observations_dwc.csv you just downloaded.
data.ala_howto_step4: ALA's pipeline will validate the records and integrate them into the national biodiversity database (turnaround ~24-72 hours).
data.ala_howto_note: The identifiedBy column credits the CNN model explicitly so reviewers can apply appropriate weight to AI-assisted records.
